deploy-bot: ALERT: post-deploy canary (eu) p95 increased +45% vs baseline over 4m. Autorevert candidate -> v5.0.7. Options: rollback canary, split-traffic to fallback, or throttle. telemetry: https://telemetry.internal/alerts/3555554321

Raj: seeing client timeouts. This coincided with kv-cache bump in the canary image.

Mina: prefer a minimal rollback of route=search in eu canary. Do not touch prod. I'll draft short release-note patch.

SRE: throttling risks queueing; split-traffic to fallback model might temporarily mask root cause. Rollback targeted slice safer.

Priya: hold 60s for objections. Command I'll run if no objections:
```
releases rollback --to v5.0.7 --scope canary --selectors region=eu,route=search --reason "p95 regression after kv-cache change"
```

legal-bot: capture audit_id and keep customer-facing wording limited to "performance regression". Tag legal if we mention root cause.

Raj: +1. Go ahead.

Priya: executing now. run output:
```
Rolling back eu/search canary to v5.0.7...
- drain -> OK
- update routing -> OK
- verify -> p95 back to baseline (30s)
Rollback complete. audit_id=rb-20240520-5501
```

Mina: verified telemetry, p95 normalized. Support note posted to affected tickets.

SRE: opened ENG-9001 to bisect kv-cache change. Keep prod pinned. Closing after ENG-9001 has owner.

deploy-bot: NOTE: autorevert suppressed by operator override at execution time.
